verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to version, review, or roll back user automations. The published versioning policy covers the vendor's own API versions (semver, six months' deprecation notice), not user automations. The Google Sheets and Zapier guides describe workflows built and run in third-party tools, which is host-platform capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
